Our New QT + Mini Smart App

The MyoLift™ app is reimagining microcurrent treatments for at-home use, pairing seamlessly with our MyoLift™ Mini and QT devices. From step-by-step tutorials to personalized progress tracking, it’s the most advanced companion on your skin health journey—all at your fingertips.

settings.title: Personalized Skin Plan
settings.sub_text: Take a quick 2-minute skin survey to unlock a personalized plan with MyoLift™ QT. Get app-exclusive treatments with three microcurrent levels, follow step-by-step guided sessions, or use App Free Mode for a simple 15 minute treatment.  Need more control? Our Custom Mode lets you create your own session by choosing the duration, intensity, and applicator.

settings.title: One App, Two Devices
settings.sub_text: Easily switch between the MyoLift QT and Mini device, both tailored to help you master the proper movements using step by step tutorials.

settings.title: Follow Along Videos
settings.sub_text: Enjoy uniquely curated protocols for all different types of treatments! These treatments range from full face, to quick minute eyebrow lifts!

settings.title: APP FREE MODE
settings.sub_text: Take your MyoLift™ QT Plus anywhere with this new app free mode! This allows you to use the device without a smartphone,right out of the box,making treatments even easier. Simply choose your desired intensity level and the app will allow you to do 5 minutes on Stretch Mode and 10 minutes on Lift mode.

settings.title: Personalized Treatments
settings.sub_text: After completing a series of questions around your skin concerns and goals, the app will generate a personal treatment plan for you to easily follow along! These treatments are diversified and vary from beginner to advance depending upon your skin analysis!

settings.title: Real-Time Progress Tracker
settings.sub_text: Track your milestones after just three sessions to measure consistency, view rewards and points as you progress, and compare before-and-after results directly in the app to stay motivated.

settings.title: Earn 7e Rewards
settings.sub_text: Earn rewards by completing Earn 7e reward points by completing your sessions consistently and redeem them as gift card credit toward your next purchase.

settings.title: One-Stop Shopping
settings.sub_text: Shop your must-have 7e Microcurrent Skincare essentials, explore new releases as soon as they launch, and get exclusive early-access alerts for sales, promotions, and limited-time offers.

settings.title: PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
settings.sub_text: The MyoLift™ QT now comes with the ability to purchase a premium membership. Purchase the device for $229 only and try out all premium app features free for 30 days! After that you can upgrade to a premium monthly, yearly, or lifetime membership.  All devices purchased prior to 1/12/24 will automatically come with a lifetime premium membership.

settings.title: ADVANCED AI SKIN ANALYSIS
settings.sub_text: Experience the power of AI to understand your skin better. This scientifically validated tool will empower even the most inexperienced users to treat their skin and track their results with the accuracy and understanding of a professional.This revolutionary tool uses real-time image analysis based on parameters such as Moisture Levels, Wrinkle formations and Firmness. Get noticeable results effortlessly with this powerful anti-aging device.

settings.title: Esthetician 1 On 1 Access
settings.sub_text: Take advantage of our library of estheticians and connect one on one  with a local professional in your area

settings.title: Live Webinars
settings.sub_text: Join us weekly for free webinars on various microcurrent  topics, lead by one of our professional team members. Learn more about the MyoLift QT and educate yourself for free!
